description: List the resource types this server can snapshot, diff and sync (metafield definitions, metaobjects, pages, menus, products...). Returns [{ kind, default, description }]: kind is the value to pass in the resources argument of snapshot_store, export_snapshot, diff_stores and plan_sync; default tells whether it is read when resources is omitted; description says how items are keyed and what is copied. Use it to choose resources; use list_stores for the stores themselves. Takes no arguments and makes no Shopify calls.
name: list_resource_types
title: List syncable resource types
